label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: A hidden-looking side cart (Close Side Cart, My Cart, Check Out) is read before the banner and main content on every page, and says Your cart is empty, which is confusing.
After activating Add to Cart nothing was announced and focus stayed on the button; I only learned the cart had updated after reading the page again.
The product carousel repeats every product twice, and the page has two Previous slide and Next slide buttons with identical names, so it is hard to know which carousel they control.
Product page is very long with a More To Explore list of Add to Cart items that are plain text with no button name, so I cannot tell which product each Add to Cart belongs to.
Express checkout buttons and card fields are inside iframes, and the Address field is a combobox with 226-option country and 62-option state lists, which is heavy to operate by keyboard.
